name: flow
description: Desktop (1280x720) and phone-viewport (390x844) menu flow from the normal title: skirmish setup, match, pause and results through Forfeit. play.html redirects to the root app. Route telemetry records screen history; clip probes inspect visible panel bounds/overflow, and the dev-bar probe checks that development controls stay hidden without ?dev. Screenshots require visual review for readability.

jobs.name: flow-desktop
keys: eval@clip-title:(() => { const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.title-screen, .title-menu, .screen-card, .game-shell .paper, .hud-bottom')) { if (!el.getClientRects().length) continue; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.left < -1 || r.top < -1 || r.right > innerWidth + 1 || r.bottom > innerHeight + 1 || el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2 && !/auto|scroll/.test(getComputedStyle(el).overflowY)) out.push(el.id || el.className); } return out; })()

eval@clip-setup:(() => { const out = []; for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.title-screen, .title-menu, .screen-card, .game-shell .paper, .hud-bottom')) { if (!el.getClientRects().length) continue; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.left < -1 || r.top < -1 || r.right > innerWidth + 1 || r.bottom > innerHeight + 1 || el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2 && !/auto|scroll/.test(getComputedStyle(el).overflowY)) out.push(el.id || el.className); } return out; })()
waitfor:(() => { const g = window.__tmtGame; return !!g && g.ready === true && g.ui?.screen === 'match'; })()
eval@devbar:(() => { const bar = document.getElementById('dev-bar'); return !!bar && bar.hidden && !bar.getClientRects().length; })()
